research_question: Under fixed retrieved candidates and task-authored graph edges, how does the official Graph-of-Skills reverse-aware PPR structural core compare with exact typed prerequisite completion?

official_graph_of_skills.paper_title: Graph of Skills: Dependency-Aware Structural Retrieval for Massive Agent Skills
official_graph_of_skills.full_hybrid_blocker: No OpenAI, Gemini, or OpenRouter embedding credential is configured; official docs require the query embedding model to match the indexed workspace.
official_graph_of_skills.label_requirement: Results must be called the official reverse-PPR structural component with fixed seeds, never a reproduction of the full hybrid GoS pipeline.

interpretation_boundary: This is a two-task dev diagnostic with three model repetitions, not a held-out generalization result.
Model repetitions measure execution stability and are not independent tasks.
The full hybrid semantic-lexical GoS pipeline is not run and must not be inferred from the fixed-seed structural component.
Prerequisite and dataflow mappings are reported separately; co_use, alternative, and conflict receive no success claim.
